17.name: Operational Export & Interoperability
17.scope: Provide deterministic operational export of canonical QA-AI artifacts to interoperable spreadsheet/tabular representations without making exports authoritative or weakening canonical semantics.
17.freeze_evidence: Human QC confirmed PASS on 2026-08-18 after the My Rewards 3.0 operational export pilot and full deterministic validation.

18.name: Test Execution & Defect Feedback
18.scope: Establish deterministic test execution evidence, canonical result statuses, run lifecycle, defect/evidence linkage, retest history, current disposition, summary reconciliation, and provenance without taking ownership of external defect workflow or automated execution.
18.freeze_evidence: Human QC confirmed PASS on 2026-08-18 after RUN-P18-001 and final deterministic gates.

19.name: Change Intelligence & Incremental QA
19.scope: Turn revision evidence and registered dependencies into explainable change sets, supported impact propagation, and incremental QA recommendations without automatically regenerating, approving, marking Current, selecting regression tiers, or executing tests.
exit_criteria: Canonical change, impact, and incremental-plan contracts and schemas are defined.
Deterministic comparison preserves Added, Modified, Removed, Unchanged, and Unknown without inventing business behavior.
Impact propagation uses registered artifact/source dependencies and does not invent technical coupling.
Every registered artifact receives one explainable incremental QA action: Reuse, Review, Regenerate, Revalidate, Re-execute, or Blocked.
Unknown or unsupported change does not become an authoritative regenerate/re-execute instruction.
Change, impact, action IDs and aggregate counts reconcile exactly.
Change intelligence remains evidence/planning and does not mutate canonical artifact lifecycle, freshness, regression scope, or execution results.
A controlled revision pilot demonstrates both affected and unaffected assets and passes Human QC plus full repository validation.
